parts:
I am creating an app. I want the app to have a feature where users can create posts. I want to be able to display the posts as Cards, sort of giving a preview of the post. And when the user clicks on the card, it should show the entire post. Can you write me code that creates that card? Feel free to utilize @MUI components. 
The post card should have:  
- a title 
- a body
- A button to view post
